title: format.json
description: Video-format recipe (the channel 'show bible') for The Automation Desk. Single source of truth for the production-policy knobs that used to live as prose (STYLE_GUIDE/skills) + hardcoded constants (build-props/anim/theme): hook, motion, pacing, captions, length, intro/outro, scene set, per-archetype structure. pipeline/shared/formats/default.json is the COMPLETE base; formats/<series-or-archetype>.json files SHALLOW-OVERRIDE it (they are partial, so they are validated only via the merged result — never standalone); per-video brief.format overrides last. Resolved by pipeline/shared/lib/format.mjs.

extends.description: Optional base format name this overrides (default: 'default').

target_seconds.description: The hook should land by ~this time.

answer_first_seconds.description: Answer the topic's core question within this opening window (D-026).

first_seconds.description: Opening window (long-form) that must carry strong visual detail + a hook-class scene.

short_first_seconds.description: Opening window for the Short — tighter than the long-form (Short psychology: the hook must land in the first ~3s). Used by the hook QA gate when vertical.

require_hook_class_scene.description: The opening window must use a hook-class scene, not a static card.

intensity.description: Global motion budget. calm = hold where the narration carries it; lively = more movement.

max_moving_elements.description: Cap on simultaneously-animating elements so motion stays purposeful, not constant.

ambient.description: Subtle continuous background drift. false since D-068 (owner, 2026-10-09): background motion is occasional, never constant — the 3D kit enforces it through motion.budget.ambient.

emphasis.description: Pop / underline on emphasized words or beats.

default_engine.description: Per-scene engine default; a scene may override. HyperFrames only for 1-3 hero beats.

budget.description: The HW.motion budget (templates/hyperframes/_lib/hf-world.js, MOTION_SPEC §16) that compile-hyperframes hands every HyperFrames scene whose props carry no `motion` of their own (D-068). Relative to the 024 long cut = 1.

ambient_scale.description: The background clock (dust drift, tile twinkle, idle bobbing) × ambient_scale.

ambient.description: Scene-local [t0, t1] windows where the background may move; [] = still background. A scene that wants a window authors its own props.motion.

focus_scale.description: Camera + background clock inside a key-take focus window.

ease.description: Seconds to settle into / out of a window.

voice.description: Default narration pace (D-068). A brief's voice_rate / voice_rate_key override it; scripts/make_voice.py and make_voice_azure.py read it from formats/default.json.

rate_key.description: Rate for the script's key takes (scenes[].key_takes).

lead_seconds.description: Start a sub-element reveal slightly BEFORE its word so the animation lands on cue.

max_static_hold_seconds.description: A sparse scene (lower-third/transition) held longer than this with no dynamic reveals is flagged as an empty/static hold (no-empty-scene rule).

max_words.description: Words per caption chunk (keeps it <= max_lines at the caption font size).

gap_seconds.description: Start a fresh chunk after a pause this long.

tail_seconds.description: Keep a chunk on screen this long after its last word.

sentence_breaks.description: Start a fresh chunk at every sentence end (default off: chunks may span a sentence break). Key takes (script scenes[].key_takes) always break at their edges either way (024 Short, 2026-10-09).

custom_ratio_min.description: Minimum fraction of bespoke/custom scenes so videos aren't the base gallery on repeat (variety rule).

archetype_structure.description: Per-archetype beat skeleton (was prose in STYLE_GUIDE §5 / script-writing 'Write to the archetype').
